title: An adaptive brief that changes with the decision
summary: A small test for making AI-generated product guidance feel more intentional, legible, and human.

blocks.content:
AI can generate a hundred directions in seconds. The harder design problem is deciding how much guidance a person needs in a particular moment—and how to give it without taking away their agency.

This sample explores a small control surface for shaping that guidance. It treats tone and direction as explicit design decisions instead of incidental properties of a prompt.
The goal is not to make the interface sound clever. It is to help the person understand what is changing, why it matters, and what they can do next.
